fun_facts: George Kittle’s hometown is Norman, Oklahoma, where he attended Norman High School.
In four seasons at Iowa, George Kittle played 49 games and recorded 48 catches, 737 receiving yards, and 10 touchdowns.
At the 2017 NFL Combine, George Kittle ranked third among tight ends in both the 40-yard dash (4.52 seconds) and broad jump (11 feet).
George Kittle set the NFL single-season receiving-yards record for a tight end in 2018 with 1,377 yards.
George Kittle’s first-down celebration and mantra were inspired by Mexican wrestler Pentagon.
